title: 1 dead, 6 hurt as SUV rams 6 vehicles
summary: A sport utility vehicle (SUV) driver was arrested after his vehicle rammed into three cars and four motorcycles, killing one person and injuring at least six others as it traveled from Tomas Morato…

blocks.text: A sport utility vehicle (SUV) driver was arrested after his vehicle rammed into three cars and four motorcycles, killing one person and injuring at least six others as it traveled from Tomas Morato Avenue toward Elliptical Road in Quezon City around 3 a.m. Sunday, Sept. 6. The Quezon City Police District (QCPD) Traffic Sector 4 identified the SUV driver as alias “Carl.” The SUV was first involved in a collision along Tomas Morato Avenue before heading toward Quezon Avenue, where it crashed again, and later toward Elliptical Road, where it figured in further accidents. Responding personnel from Traffic Sector 4 immediately took the driver into custody. The motorcycle rider was declared dead, while the injured victims were rushed to East Avenue Medical Center and Quezon City General Hospital for treatment. The QCPD is conducting a follow-up investigation to determine the exact circumstances surrounding the successive collisions and the liability of the driver.
